database:primary-key:note.decision: uuid (text) primary key for Note and Tag in the unified app; A's integer ids kept in legacy_id during migration, B's uuids kept as-is

application:api:note-update-semantics.decision: Update whitelists title and body; unknown fields rejected with 400; pin/unpin and tags have their own endpoints

application:business-rule:notes.list.ord.decision: One order everywhere: pinned first, then created_at descending (keeps A's order for unpinned notes, adds B's pinning); not configurable

application:database:jotter-data-in-memo.decision: B has no stored data; import only from a JSON dump of GET /api/notes if the user supplies one, otherwise nothing to migrate

application:database:labels-to-tags.decision: Map each distinct trimmed, case-folded label to one tag and link it; log merged variants

database:duplicate-entity:note.decision: Merge into one Note table: id, legacy_id, title, body (B content), pinned, created_at, updated_at; field origins listed in architecture.json

dependency:runtime-mix:backend-runtime.decision: One backend runtime: Python (A's runtime); B's features rebuilt in Python

application:application:export-filenames.decision: File name = slugified title + '-' + first 8 characters of the uuid + '.md'

database:naming-style:fields.decision: snake_case for all tables and fields; B's camelCase mapped (updatedAt -> updated_at)

migration:note.decision: PLAN ONLY (approved as a plan, not for execution): re-key A's notes and tags to uuid with legacy_id, rewrite note_tags FKs, import B's optional JSON dump; backup, dry run, checks and rollback in design/migration-plan.md. Running it needs a separate migration approval.

migration:notetag.decision: PLAN ONLY (approved as a plan, not for execution): rewrite A's note_tags integer FKs to the new uuids through legacy_id, then drop duplicate pairs; checks in design/migration-plan.md. Running it needs a separate migration approval.

migration:tag.decision: PLAN ONLY: re-key A's tags to uuid with legacy_id; case-variant names merge (logged). Not for execution without a migration approval.
